item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 03/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Haikui will enter the Taiwan Strait tomorrow. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, the weather will be very hot over Guangdong. Haikui will then move in the general direction of the vicinity of the coast of eastern Guangdong to southern Fujian, and bring showers to eastern Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week, but its movement remains uncertain. Tropical Cyclone Saola will move across the vicinity of Beibu Wan, and continue to weaken tomorrow.
